scope: Archive 048, the Operation Battle command prompts. 196 records over 70 distinct lines, authored by source line. Identical in both revisions.
provenance: Claude translator-authored Japanese to Korean, 2026-09-20; no independent review yet
tone: Each Navi asks for orders in its own voice, so the politeness level and verbal tics vary line by line: 거츠맨's 〜でガス becomes 〜가스, the 〜っぴゅ Navi becomes 〜삐유, the katakana machine voices stay clipped, and the archaic one keeps 그대/하겠다.
